hero.desc: Applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) and vector mathematics to modern recruitment, connecting candidates and companies with transparent, data-driven precision.

story.title: Built to Solve Real-World Hiring Challenges
story.p1: In traditional recruitment, HR teams face hundreds of resumes across fragmented formats. Manual screening is time-consuming and prone to missing qualified talent simply because phrasing does not strictly match keywords in the job description (JD).
story.p2: For job seekers, submitting applications without knowing skill alignment against enterprise requirements often results in uncertainty and discouraging response rates.
story.p3: Verisem was created to solve these challenges through practical technology: accurate document parsing, standardized domain-specific skill taxonomies, and semantic similarity scoring via Cosine Similarity vector algorithms.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To deliver an objective, transparent, and scientifically grounded profile evaluation platform for the modern workforce. Empowering candidates to identify skill gaps and helping employers drastically minimize screening costs and time.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: Continuously refining our normalized skill dictionary and semantic embedding models to become the premier intelligent ATS ecosystem for tech talent and enterprises globally.

values.title: Core Values
values.subtitle: The technical and ethical principles guiding every feature built on the Verisem platform.
values.speed_desc: Automating resume parsing and preliminary screening with NLP algorithms, saving recruiters dozens of manual review hours per hiring cycle.
values.transparent_desc: Every compatibility score is derived from direct cross-examination between skills, experience in the CV and requirement benchmarks in the JD.
values.technical_desc: No artificial marketing hype. We focus strictly on optimizing Vector Cosine Similarity algorithms and industry-standard skill taxonomies.
values.user_first_desc: Technology serves as an intelligent assistant helping candidates self-diagnose competencies and enabling employers to discover top potential objectively.

hero.desc: Explore Verisem's core NLP technology and vector matching engine. Simplifying recruitment, boosting precision, and connecting the right talent with the ideal role.

modules.m1_desc: Advanced document extraction algorithms supporting PDF and DOCX formats. Automatically structures education, career history, and classifies skills against technical dictionaries, normalizing lexical variations (e.g., React, ReactJS, and React.js resolve to a single canonical term).
modules.m2_desc: Converts resume content and job descriptions into high-dimensional semantic text embeddings. Evaluates multi-dimensional cosine angles combined with weighted skill matrices to produce accurate compatibility scores (0 - 100%), transcending mechanical keyword counting.
modules.m3_desc: Enables candidates to pre-evaluate resumes against target job descriptions prior to official submission. Visualizes matched skills, missing competencies, and actionable recommendations to optimize application competitiveness.
modules.m3_highlight: Clear insights into strengths & skill gaps
modules.m4_desc: Unified employer dashboard to track applicants across hiring milestones: Applied, Screened, Interview, Offered, or Rejected. Features multi-criteria filtering by official administrative locations, work arrangements (Remote/On-site/Hybrid), and salary brackets.
modules.m5_desc: Personal documents stored in the candidate library remain completely confidential. Employers can only view full contact details and download original resumes if and only if the candidate explicitly applies to their active job posting.
modules.m6_desc: Transparent credit quota system for AI tasks (scoring, extraction). Integrated with instant QR bank transfers and automated webhook synchronization, provisioning subscription plans and credits 24/7 without manual approval delays.

hero.desc: Guidelines, rights, and contractual terms governing your use of the Verisem recruitment and evaluation platform.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p1: By creating an account, accessing, or utilizing any feature of the Verisem platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be legally bound by these Terms of Service.
s1.p2: If you do not agree with any provision of these terms, please discontinue using our services and contact our support team for clarification.

s2.title: 2. Service Description & Technology
s2.intro: Verisem provides an intelligent recruitment platform powered by Natural Language Processing (NLP) and vector semantic matching algorithms (Cosine Similarity). The platform serves two primary user categories:
s2.applicant_desc: Provides a private CV repository, location-based job search with standardized administrative divisions, and a self-scoring simulator to analyze matched vs. missing skills against specific job descriptions.
s2.employer_desc: Offers job posting tools, candidate intake pipelines, stage progression tracking, and automated semantic compatibility scores for swift preliminary screening.

s3.title: 3. User Responsibilities
s3.sub1_desc: Candidates warrant that all information provided in resumes (work history, skills, credentials) is truthful and accurate. Employers warrant that job advertisements represent genuine vacancies, free from misleading terms or labor compliance violations.
s3.sub2_desc: Users are responsible for safeguarding login credentials and session tokens. Sharing accounts with unauthorized third parties is strictly prohibited.

s4.title: 4. Plans, Quotas & Billing
s4.p1: The system provides periodic recurring plans (Monthly / Annual) and on-demand AI Credit top-up packs. Payments are processed securely via automated VietQR bank transfer webhooks.
s4.p2: While an active plan remains valid, user protection rules apply: users can upgrade to higher tiers or add credits, but downgrades to lower tiers are restricted until the active billing cycle expires.

s5.title: 5. Intellectual Property
s5.p1: Users retain full intellectual ownership of all personal CVs and uploaded documents. Verisem is granted processing rights solely for text extraction, skill normalization, and score computation.
s5.p2: Source code, matching algorithms, industry skill taxonomies, user interface designs, and the Verisem brand remain the exclusive property of the platform developer.

s6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
s6.note_desc: Compatibility ratings generated by Verisem algorithms are mathematical estimates derived from textual cross-analysis. These scores serve as decision-support metrics for preliminary filtering and do not constitute an absolute guarantee of professional competency or hiring outcomes. Final recruitment decisions rest solely with the interview process between employer and candidate.

hero.desc: Our commitment to transparency, data protection, and user confidentiality across the Verisem platform.

s1.title: 1. Data Collection
s1.intro: We only collect information strictly necessary to deliver core platform functionalities:
s1.item1_desc: Full name, account email address, and securely hashed passwords.
s1.item2_desc: PDF or DOCX resume files explicitly uploaded to the candidate's personal repository.
s1.item3_desc: Company name, tax code, corporate website, brand logo, and job description texts.
s1.item4_desc: Order identifiers and VietQR transaction metadata for payment verification and auditing.

s2.title: 2. Data Processing & NLP Algorithms
s2.p1: Uploaded resumes are processed by secure text-extraction algorithms to identify educational background, work experience, and technical competencies.
s2.p2: Extracted text is transformed into high-dimensional vector embeddings to compute Cosine Similarity distances against job specifications. All calculations execute securely on Verisem internal servers; we strictly never sell or trade candidate profile data with third parties.

s3.title: 3. Transparent Data Sharing Mechanism
s3.note_desc: A candidate's resume and contact information are only transferred to an employer when the candidate deliberately clicks "Apply" for that specific job posting. Prior to applying, no employer can search, browse, or download your private CV files from the repository.

s4.title: 4. Data Storage & Security
s4.p1: User passwords are encrypted using one-way bcrypt hashing before storage. All communications between browser and servers are secured via standard HTTPS encryption.
s4.p2: Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) ensures users can only access data within their explicit authorization scope.

s5.title: 5. User Control & Rights
s5.intro: You retain full control over your personal data on Verisem:
s5.item1: Modify or permanently delete CV versions from your personal library at any time.
s5.item2: Request account information updates or corrections via Settings or the Online Support center.
s5.item3: Withdraw job applications or request direct technical assistance through our Support portal.

hero.desc: Find quick answers to common questions or submit a direct ticket to the Verisem engineering team.

faqs.a: The platform utilizes Natural Language Processing (NLP) to parse and understand your resume, converting content into high-dimensional text vectors. AI algorithms then calculate Cosine Similarity between your resume vector and the job description vector to provide an accurate compatibility rating, eliminating rigid keyword counting.

faqs.q: Is my personal information kept confidential?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted and securely stored. Resumes are only disclosed to an employer when you explicitly submit an application for their open position. We strictly adhere to our published Privacy Policy.

faqs.q: How can an employer verify their company account (KYC)?
faqs.a: Employers must provide a valid Tax Identification Number and an image of their Business Registration Certificate in Account Settings. Our moderation team verifies credentials against national registries within 2-4 business hours.

faqs.q: How many resumes can I store in my library?
faqs.a: Standard candidate accounts (Free) can upload and maintain up to 5 distinct resume versions to tailor applications for different professional specializations.
